_comment: Runs judge-jev after each tool use. JUDGE_JEV_INPUT must point at a JSON file
Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 review, 3 escalate, 4 skip, 10 operational error.
This template blocks only on escalate (3) and lets every other outcome through;
drop the `case` to block on fail as well. Do not add `|| true`: that discards
the verdict and makes the hook decorative.
Add --mock to judge without an API key; it returns canned answers, so a mocked
hook must never be treated as a real safety check.

hooks.command: bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/judge-jev" run --rubric agent-trajectory --input "$JUDGE_JEV_INPUT"; code=$?; case $code in 3) echo "judge-jev: escalated for human review" >&2; exit 2 ;; 10|11) echo "judge-jev: could not judge (exit $code)" >&2; exit 0 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac'
